headlines.title_zh: 谷歌Gemini驱动人形机器人进厂
headlines.title_en: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot
headlines.event_summary_zh: 谷歌发布Gemini 2.5机器人模型，在奔驰工厂测试中实现96%金属件分拣成功率，展现出更强的泛化操作能力
headlines.event_summary_en: Google DeepMind unveiled the Gemini 2.5 robotic model, integrating vision, language, and motion control to operate diverse hardware like Apptronik robots. In pilot tests at Mercedes-Benz plants, the model achieved a 96% success rate and increased task speed by up to 30%.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】谷歌DeepMind、Apptronik、奔驰在匈牙利与德国的奔驰工厂生产线：推出Gemini 2.5模型，并在真实工业环境下达成96%的分拣成功率
【起因与机理】旨在验证大模型跨硬件平台的通用操控能力，加速AI从数字世界向物理空间的落地
【关键数据与实测】在奔驰生产线实测，分拣成功率达96%，效率显著提升。
【观点态度】旨在实现跨平台通用控制，推进工业领域AI部署。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Google DeepMind, Apptronik, Mercedes-Benz: Launched Gemini 2.5, achieving 96% accuracy in metal parts sorting in real-world environments
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To validate general-purpose robot control using foundation models and accelerate physical AI deployment
[Key Metrics] Achieved 96% success rate in real-world automotive assembly tests.
[Perspective & Impact] Focusing on cross-platform compatibility and industrial AI scalability.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 谷歌这是把人形机器人从“杂耍艺人”送进“流水线打工”，以后不仅要担心被AI抢走办公室白领的饭碗，连蓝领的岗位也彻底不保了。奔驰雇佣机器人倒是不闹罢工，就是不知道这昂贵的模型授权费，最后会不会变成我们要买的汽车溢价。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Google is transitioning humanoid robots from 'circus performers' to 'assembly line workers,' ensuring that not only white-collar jobs but also blue-collar roles are under existential threat. It's great that robots don't go on strike, but I wonder if those hefty model licensing fees will just end up as extra digits on our next car invoice.

人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

人们不应该将对未来的控制权交给超级智能，而这一要求最终应该限制人工智能的进步。

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
